g.title: MDD20A
g.text: Labels as printed on the board. POWER has NO reverse polarity protection.

g.title: PICO
g.text: Powered by USB only – no battery wire to the Pico.

g.title: Control wires
g.text: jumper wires, bare ends into green screw terminal

g.title: ALARM
g.text: Black wire on the "-" pin (the end marked with a minus). Unplug after driving, it slowly drains the battery.
